research_question: Does the first session-VWAP retest after a high-activity four-hour opening drive resume toward the opening-drive extreme after opposite-flow absorption and an independent fifteen-minute reacceptance?

sources: institutional VWAP execution and anchored-VWAP trading practice
opening-drive and first-pullback discretionary day-trading playbooks
order-flow absorption and auction reacceptance concepts
reused: a high-volume opening drive establishes context rather than an entry
the first pullback to anchored session VWAP is the liquidity interaction
opposite signed flow with limited price acceptance is treated as absorption candidate
entry waits for a separate completed reacceptance bar

scenario.context: the first completed four UTC hours move at least one prior twenty-four-hour ATR with above-prior-median opening quote volume
scenario.liquidity_objective: the high or low of that completed opening drive
scenario.interaction: the first later completed fifteen-minute bar touching anchored session VWAP carries taker pressure opposite the opening drive but closes on the drive side of VWAP and does not invalidate the session open

state.BREADTH_OPENING_DRIVE: at least three markets share the opening-drive direction
state.RELATIVE_OPENING_DRIVE: breadth is unresolved but the focal market is the unique largest volatility-normalized opening drive

scenario.confirmation: the next completed fifteen-minute bar moves in the drive direction, stays on the drive side of anchored VWAP, closes directionally within its range and has aligned taker pressure
scenario.invalidation: beyond the VWAP-interaction extreme plus ten percent of prior twenty-four-hour ATR
scenario.target: the completed opening-drive high or low
scenario.management: target or stop first; otherwise exit at UTC day end
scenario.arbitration: one global open position and one causal attempt per symbol/day

data.source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly and latest daily five-minute klines
data.visibility: opening context is complete at 04:00 UTC; VWAP uses only bars completed through each interaction/confirmation; target is fixed from the completed opening drive

advance_gate.final_integrated_system_frequency_requir: at least one independent completed trade per calendar day

decision_contract.advance: Only a fixed route positive in every declared split advances to NautilusTrader.
decision_contract.reject: Do not alter opening hours, VWAP interaction, flow, confirmation, stop or target rules after evaluation.
